artDirection: Premium painted HD-2D fantasy tactical RPG journey in the canonical forest route. Keep the scene creature-neutral: only wind, disturbed vegetation, tracks, distant pressure, and restrained company concern. Never reveal, silhouette, name, or imply a specific monster species or combat composition.

shots.purpose: Establish forward travel through the forest route without identifying the encounter ahead.
shots.promptIntent: Seraphine advances only a few measured steps toward screen right while leaves and grass shift in a light wind. Keep the distant path empty and show no creature, eyes, claws, weapon strike, or attack.

shots.purpose: Turn neutral travel into unease through a company reaction and subtle vegetation movement.
shots.promptIntent: Seraphine stops and makes one restrained glance toward brush offscreen right as foliage stirs and then settles. The cause remains completely unseen and species-neutral; finish on a sharp, readable reaction frame.
